source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e, folder secretsofthenorth; corrected against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

rewards: Ability to mine ancient essence crystals in the Ghorrock Dungeon
Access to a new boss, the Phantom Muspah

st.t: Talk to the guard outside of the Carnillean Mansion in East Ardougne.
Climb the stairs in Carnillean Mansion and talk to the guard there.
Inspect Ceril Carnillean's body.
Inspect the broken Window on the East side of the room.
Knock-at the wall on the North side of the room.
Climb the Ladder.
Inspect the chest.
Descend the ladder and talk to the guard about what you've found. Tell him all three things, then say that is everything.
s: The window was broken from the outside.
A hidden room above us was broken into.
I think I've gone over everything.

st.t: Climb down the staircase.
Head to the Fight Arena Bar and talk to the Khazard Barman.
s: Do you know anyone called Evelot?

st.t: Inspect the barrels outside the Fight Arena Bar entrance.
Inspect the boulder to the north.
Continue north and inspect the bush there.
Inspect the stump to the east.
Inspect the boulder to the south east.
Inspect the bush to the east.
Approach Evelot to the east to start the fight. Protect from melee and reactivate prayer after she special attacks.
Talk to Evelot again after the fight.
Enter the cave that leads to the Ardougne sewers, near the Clock Tower.
Board the raft. If it takes you across, skip the valve steps below. If it doesn't move, go back up out of the cave.
Only if the raft didn't move: turn the valve just north of the cave to the left.
Only if the raft didn't move: go west to the south end of the bridge by the Carnilleans' house and turn the valve there to the right.
Only if the raft didn't move: cross the bridge, go north-east and turn the next valve to the right.
Only if the raft didn't move: cross back over the river, head east towards the zoo's penguin cage and turn the valve there to the right.
Only if the raft didn't move: go south-east past the monk and turn the last valve to the right.
Only if the raft didn't move: go back into the cave and board the raft.
Talk to Alomone or Clivet inside the cult area.
Talk to Hazeel.
Return to the Carnillean Mansion and speak to the Guard.
Climb down the ladder into the basement of the mansion.
Talk to Claus the Chef.
Search the cooking shelves for a button.
Inspect the wall next to the noticeboard.
Picklock the chest. The answer stays the same between attempts, and several pins can share a number. Green means a pin is right.
Set every pin to 1 and confirm. Leave the green pins as they are, change all the others to 2 and confirm again. Carry on with 3, 4 and so on until every pin is green. It takes 6 tries at most.
Inspect the dusty scroll.
Return to Hazeel and tell him about the scroll.
Talk to Big Fish at the north entrance to Weiss.
Talk to Snowflake.
s: Have you seen anything odd around here recently?

st.t: Talk to Big Fish (Hazeel) at the north entrance to Weiss again.
s: Why would the killer come here?
What is this ritual you keep talking about?
Okay, I'm done asking questions. What now?
I'm done asking questions. What now?

st.t: Prepare for a fight and climb down the stairs in the middle of Weiss.
Enter the cave to the south.
Defeat the assassin. Put the Assassin in the smoke bombs so you can hit him and dodge the poison vials he throws out.
Talk to General Khazard.
Talk to Hazeel to the west and tell him about what happened.
Search the barrel south of the centre room. The centre room is the gated room south of where you fought the assassin.
Enter the centre room. Use the code "BLOOD" to unlock the gate.
Open the north chest using the code "7402".
Get a tinderbox from the crate in the west of the central room.
Light the North West Brazier.
Light the South East Brazier.
Light the North East Brazier.
Light the South West Brazier.
Open the western chest.
Open the north gate using the code LEFT - UP - LEFT - DOWN.
Use the handle on the lever mechanism
Pull the lever.
Inspect the south west pillar in the room where you fought the assassin.
Use the jewel shards on one another.
Use the ancient jewel on the icy chest.
Open the gate near the barrel you found the lever handle in.
Resupply if you haven't already. Bring Ranged and Magic gear, stamina potions and prayer potions for a challenging fight, then enter the crevice.
Defeat the Strange Creature.
Speak to Jhallan in the Muspah room.
Talk to Hazeel inside the ruins for a teleport to Ardougne.
Return to the guard outside of the Carnillean Mansion in East Ardougne to finish the quest. Talk to Hazeel for a teleport to Ardougne.
